I built the vote-by-mail flyer in scene s1c66bdd819 and rendered all three sizes: portrait, wide and sky. The checks came back with no layout defects and nothing needed fixing. One thing to watch: with the sky size scaled to 0.28, the smallest text (the footer) comes out at about 7.8px, which may be too small to read in that ad slot.

In every size, the photo band and red "VOTE BY MAIL" bar stay full width. The three candidate columns stay evenly spaced, and the photo crops instead of stretching.
